notes.title: PATCH NOTES V2.1.0 - Foundations Reforged
notes.content:
[b]Patch 2.1.0[/b] brings a graphical revamp to the RPG Mode's world, focusing on visual fidelity. [i]Many features previously announced are not included in this update but are planned for Patch 2.2.0 (and potentially 2.3.0)[/i]. This update also includes crucial bug fixes that address major gameplay and audio issues. This patch is primarily focused on quality improvements and will significantly enhances the game’s aesthetic and technical performance. Here’s a breakdown of the changes:

[h2]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS [RPG Mode] [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Starting City Rebuilt:[/b] Nearly all 3D models in the starting city have been entirely reworked, offering sharper detail and a more immersive look.
[*] [b]Other Cities Enhanced: [/b]Key buildings in the other two cities have also been upgraded to match the new visual standard.
[*] [b]Stone Roads: [/b]Realistic stone roads have been added throughout all cities for a more grounded and visually coherent environment.
[*] [b]Foliage : [/b]The entire foliage has been redesigned featuring brand-new animated trees and grass. Performance improvements have also been made, but they will be more noticeable in upcoming updates.
[/list]
[h2]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the final zone music would incorrectly play after exiting the Ancient Portal menu without teleporting.
[*] Players were no longer instantly teleported after defeating the final boss.
[*] In Platformer Mode, players could no longer move through certain endgame menus.
[*] The ultimate attack of the final boss (The Sovereign) now lasts 9 seconds instead of 19, making the fight more dynamic and less drawn-out.
[/list]
[h2]KNOWN ISSUES (Still Under Investigation)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some missions are incorrectly marked as completed multiple times once for each player in the session. (RPG Mode)
[*] On rare occasions, a player may be unable to deal damage to another player. The cause is still under investigation. (RPG Mode)
[*] Background music may switch abruptly or overlap without clear triggers. (Both Modes)
[/list]
The root causes of these bugs are still unknown.

[h2]NOTES[/h2]
[u]This update took longer than usual due to academic obligations thanks for your patience![/u]
Looking ahead, the next update will focus on both content and quality, including:
[list]
[*] Side quests
[*] Quest indicators in menus
[*] Combo systems for players
[*] Camera effects
[*] Character movement improvements
[*] Smarter enemy AI
[/list]

notes.title: Major RPG Overhaul Coming Soon
notes.content:
The [u]RPG Mode[/u] of [b]Odyssey: Realm of Echoes[/b] will soon receive its [b][u]biggest technical update yet![/u][/b] This won’t be a content update, but a [u]massive quality upgrade[/u] that will refine and enhance every aspect of the mode.
[h2]What to Expect?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fully remade 3D assets – Every model in the RPG Mode will be improved for a more polished look
[*] Polished character animations – Movements will feel smoother, more fluid, and more natural
[*] Revamped combat system – A new combo system, fresh mechanics, and enhanced effects will make battles more satisfying
[*] Smarter AI – Enemies will behave more intelligently and react more dynamically
[*] Massive bug fixes – The experience will be smoother and more stable
[*] Overhauled vegetation system – The world will look better while performance will be significantly improved
[/list]

This update follows the recent overhaul of the Platformer Mode, and now it's time to bring the RPG Mode up to the same high standard!

📅 [i]Coming in the next few months[/i]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES V2.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This update focuses on improving stability, fixing key audio issues, and addressing some persistent multiplayer and platformer bugs.

[h2]Fixes and Improvements :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where players could go back and fall at the end of each dungeon level (Platformer mode)
[*] Reduced grass walk and jump sound volume (RPG Mode)
[*] Fixed sound replication for dash & jump (RPG Mode)
[*] Fixed a bug where players joining an ongoing game couldn’t see the correct number of players in the arena (RPG Mode)
[*] Fixed press, axe, and teleporting platform sounds not being affected by audio settings (they could still be heard even when audio was disabled) (Platformer Mode)

[/list]

notes.title: PATCH NOTES V2.0.0 - Complete overhaul of PLATFORMER MODE
notes.content:
The [b]platformer mode[/b] has undergone a [b]complete rework[/b], transforming it into an even more dynamic and engaging experience. Here’s a breakdown of the changes:

[h2]PLATFORMER MODE[/h2]
[i]The missions from the previous version of the platformer mode are making a comeback, but they will be completely revamped to fit the new mechanics and story structure.
The narrative will be partially changed to offer a deeper experience and a more coherent plotline as you progress through the game.[/i]
The mode will now be split into [b]4 chapters[/b], each offering a unique experience and narrative development:
[b]Chapter 1 - Introduction:[/b] The first chapter will serve as an introductory level where the character must make their way through a mysterious new setting.
[b]Chapter 2 - Forgotten Depths:[/b] The second chapter begins with a flashback, revisiting key levels from the old Chapter 2. As the memory fades, the character finds themselves in the deeper sections of the dungeon, where new dangers and intricate platforming challenges await.
[b]Chapter 3 - Abyssal Trials:[/b] This chapter also starts with a flashback, bringing back missions from the previous version before descending into the abyssal levels of the dungeon. The difficulty intensifies as the environment becomes more treacherous and demanding.
[b]The character’s movement has been completely reworked to offer smoother, more responsive gameplay, making it more engaging.[/b]
Each dungeon level will introduce [u][b]new mechanics[/b][/u], ensuring a fresh experience as you progress through the game.
The platforming sections have been given a [u][b]visual overhaul[/b][/u], featuring a unique artistic style, ensuring that each new area feels distinct.
[h3]PERFORMANCE TRACKING[/h3]
A [b]time system[/b] has been implemented for each level, allowing you to track your best completion times.
You'll also be able to access your scores for each level and compare your performance with other players.
A [b]complete list of levels[/b] is available so you can easily select any stage you’ve completed.
View your [b]scoreboards per level[/b] and track your progress to optimize your performance.
[h3]CHARACTER EVOLUTION[/h3]
The character’s appearance and equipment will also evolve as you progress through the chapters: the character will start with a basic outfit and will unlock new attire as they complete chapters, reflecting their growth and the new abilities they’ve gained.
[h2]FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Redesigned main menu.
[*] Fixed the announcement popup.
[*] Updated the Settings menu
[*] Updated the Inventory System in RPG Mode
[*] And More
[/list]

notes.title: Update Progress – Almost There!
notes.content:
Hello everyone !
It’s been three weeks since my last update. I’m happy to share that the big update is making great progress !
[u][b]The rework of the Platformer Mode is nearing completion[/b][/u], with only a few elements left to finalize:
[list]
[*] Cinematics
[*] Artistic direction refinements
[*] Additional narrative elements
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

[h2]Notable changes :[/h2]
[list]
[*] The campaign now features 17 fully redesigned levels instead of 6.
[*] Mechanics have been completely revamped, and controls feel much smoother.
[*] A "Best Times" system has been added to track your records.
[*] The level selection menu has been entirely reworked.
[/list]

If everything goes as planned, the update should be ready in two weeks!

Thanks for your patience and support !!

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.2.0 - Royal Guard & Unity
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to [u]Version 1.2.0[/u][/b], [i][u]the biggest update yet ![/u][/i] This patch introduces the new royal guard mob, the group system, a lot of gameplay fixes, and improvements to menus. Read on for the full breakdown of what's new and improved :
[list]
[*] [h2][b]Group System[/b][/h2]
[b]You can now create groups [/b]and team up with your friends! In groups :
- When beating bosses, [b]every player will receive a key[/b]
- [b]Mission progress will be shared[/b]. If one player kills a mob required for a mission, everyone's progress will increase. 
- Access the group menu by pressing "V" (default key), where you can create your own group or join others. As the group leader, you can accept or reject join requests from other players.
- When starting or joining a server, all players will see a popup encouraging them to create or join a group.

[*] [h2][b]A new foe has appeared: The Royal Guard[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164173/3e8e4bb85d984464af57cb20f213b7941008be1e.png[/img]
- Some Royal Guards did not participate in the collapse and isolation of the Fallen Kingdom from the other realms. They were on a spy mission in the 3 regions, where they set up small bases and remained stationed, awaiting orders that never came.
- These enemies are exceptionally strong, as they were the elite of the Sovereign's Army. They are classified not as regular mobs but as "Special" mobs. While not on par with bosses, two of them together can rival the strength of the Shadow Warlord.
- You will encounter them in small bases across the three regions.

[*] [h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
[b]- Fixed a bug where attacking a mob had a 75% chance of failing to land using swords[/b]
[b]- Every player who participates in a boss fight will now earn the Steam achievements, and the mission will be marked as completed if the boss is killed, provided they are still in the boss's zone and regardless of who lands the killing blow.[/b]
- Updated the mob UI to make it more adaptive to long mob names.
- Updated the main menu titles to better reflect what each mode truly represents.
- Removed the animation from the patch note popup to make it easier to read
- Improved the Multiplayer ingame lorepage
- Fixed a bug where saved mission progress would not load correctly.
- Fixed a bug where players could send messages without a size limit in the chat
- Fixed a bug where players could have negative progress in missions
[/list]
[b]The upcoming patches will focus on the game's 3D platformer mode for a major rework, as well as improvements to multiplayer UI.[/b]

notes.title: Major Update Soon
notes.content: Big changes are coming within the next 3 days to 3 weeks! A major update will introduce exciting new features, a tough new enemy, and improvements to gameplay. The new group system will allow players to team up more easily, share mission progress, and face challenges together. Players will also encounter a powerful foe in the Blossom Fields. And there's still much more to come in this update!

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.1.0 - The Orb Update
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to [u]Version 1.1.0[/u][/b], [i][u]the first major update ![/u][/i] This patch introduces the exciting new orb system, numerous gameplay fixes, and improvements to menus and shop functionalities. Read on for the full breakdown of what's new and improved :
[list]
[*] [h2]Orb System[/h2]
Players can now open [b]orbs[/b] in the shops to receive items. Each orb provides a randomized selection of items, with a chance to obtain rare rewards.
[h3]Types of Orbs :[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Normal Orb[/b]: Standard item drop rates.
[*][b]Special Orb[/b]: Higher drop rates for rare items, making it a valuable find for lucky players.
[/list]

[*] [h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
- The subsystem previously provided inaccurate ping data. To ensure clarity, this display has been disabled on the server search panel
- Fixed a bug where the displayed number of players was incorrect when someone left a server.
- Players can now sell items by using the left mouse button in addition to the right mouse button for improved ease of use.
- Shop menus now auto-adjust to match your screen’s aspect ratio
- Server passwords are no longer case-sensitive, reducing confusion caused by font differences
- The server creation interface has been slightly revamped to provide a smoother and more intuitive setup experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note V1.0.1 - First Update
notes.content:
Thank you for embarking on this journey with me. This first post-launch patch focuses on bringing you exciting new content and vital improvements to enhance your experience. Here's what's included:
[list]
[*] [h2]Exclusive new weapon[/h2]
[b]A brand-new weapon[/b] has been added to the in-game shops! For the next two weeks, you can grab this powerful item at half price to give you an edge in your adventures. Don’t miss out!

[*] [h2]Password-Protected Servers[/h2]
You can now create [b]private multiplayer sessions[/b] by setting up a password for your server

[*] [h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
- [b]21:9 screens are now fully supported[/b]
- The server creation and server selection menus have been updated
- Fixed scaling issues with several menus on different resolutions
- Fixed animation glitches in multiplayer mode
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.0.0 - Launch Update
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Odyssey: Realm of Echoes! [/h1]
[h3]I'm beyond excited to have you join me as we embark on this incredible journey. Here’s what you can expect on launch day:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [h2]Multiplayer Mode[/h2]
[b]A 3D open-world RPG[/b]. Join other players or venture solo to explore a diverse continent teeming with challenges. Face hordes of mobs and engage in epic battles against powerful mini-bosses as you work your way toward the ultimate showdown with the big boss. [b]Uncover the fate of a mysterious, vanished fourth region along the way[/b].

[*] [h2]Singleplayer Mode[/h2]
[b]A 3D platformer with a fixed camera perspective[/b]. Step into the shoes of a [b]legendary adventurer who disappeared 1,000 years ago[/b]. Your mission is to reclaim lost powers while traversing diverse environments.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45164173/3d2db1a145050c7ce278913d0408f906416e67ac.gif[/img]

[h1]Future Plans & Updates Coming Soon[/h1]
I'm committed to keeping [b]Odyssey: Realm of Echoes[/b] evolving and improving, with the following updates expected in the near future:

[list]
[*] [h2]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h2]
Regular updates to address issues and improve overall performance.

[*] [h2]Orb Openings[/h2]
New content like orbs to unlock exciting rewards and upgrades.

[*] [h2]New Equipment[/h2]
Fresh gear additions, including powerful weapons and armor sets.

[*] [h2]Major Singleplayer Improvements[/h2]
I’m working on enhancing the singleplayer experience to be more player-friendly.
[/list]

[u][h2]Please note that some updates may take time as I balance development with my ongoing studies.[/h2][/u]
